stock.name: Hinge Health, Inc.
stock.thesis: Ranked first among today's eligible candidates on revenue growth, trailing year, six-month return against spy, operating margin trend — revenue +49.9% over the trailing year, operating margin wider than a year ago, earnings fully backed by cash.

evidence.label: Earnings yield / free cash flow yield
evidence.period: trailing year against the reference close

stock.peerBasis: 105 candidates in SIC major group 73, compared on free cash flow yield, all from the same source and the same periods.

runnersUp.name: e.l.f. Beauty, Inc.
runnersUp.why: its weakest signal was earnings yield (-0.66)

runnersUp.name: Magnite, Inc.
runnersUp.why: its weakest signal was cash conversion (-0.24)

runnersUp.name: RingCentral, Inc.
runnersUp.why: its weakest signal was cash conversion (-1.15)

stock.counterargument: It is an expensive stock: 55.6× trailing earnings and a 3.4% free cash flow yield, so the growth is already in the price and one weak quarter would cost a lot. growth decelerated against the previous quarter, so the trend in the numbers is already turning.
invalidation: Quarterly revenue growth falling below +53.0%, the rate it was running at the quarter before.
Cash conversion dropping below 1.0×, meaning earnings stop being backed by cash.
A close below the 200-session average, which stood at $72.56 on the decision date.
risks: The share count is from 2026-09-30, 50 days older than the price, so the market capitalisation carries that staleness.
The most recent filing covers a period ending 2026-09-30, 50 days before the decision date.
One of the four quarters in the trailing year is the fourth quarter, which companies report only as part of the full year; it is derived as the annual figure less the first three quarters.
Point-in-time fundamentals are built from filings accepted up to 2026-11-19.

earnings.basis: the same fiscal quarter's announcement a year earlier (2026-02-10) plus 364 days

stock.rule: Universe: every US-listed common stock on NYSE, Nasdaq or NYSE American — about 4,700 names from Nasdaq Trader's own file. Eligible means: priced at $5 or more, median daily turnover of $20M or more over 60 sessions, at least 253 sessions of history, a 10-Q or 10-K whose period ended within 200 days, close above the 200-session average, volatility inside the day's 85th percentile, debt no more than 6× operating cash flow, no results announced in the last 2 sessions, and no position already open in the stock or a fourth in the same SIC division. Eligible candidates are then ranked on equally weighted z-scores within their sector group, over the signals that are defined for that group. One position per session, held 21 sessions, a twenty-first of capital each, 10 basis points of cost each way. Fundamentals are read as they stood on the decision date, never as they read today. The score is a ranking position among that day's eligible candidates. It is not a probability, a price target, or a forecast of any return.
stock.validation: The held-out window has not been opened. No claim of an edge is made or implied.

sources.fundamentals: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets (twelve quarters), point-in-time by accepted timestamp, topped up from companyfacts for companies that have filed since the newest data set

stories.title: Traumatized teens sue school, cops after Doritos bag triggers AI gun alert
stories.excerpt: Lawsuit: Over 99% of school system’s AI gun alerts were false positives.
stories.lead: In October 2025, four Black high school students were sharing Cool Ranch Doritos after football practice, winding down and waiting for their rides home. It was then, in the lull of a moment any teen with after-school activities knows well, that the school’s AI gun detection system suddenly flagged one teen holding a bag of chips as a potential gunman.

stories.title: Quiz: Python Practice Problems: Parsing CSV Files
stories.excerpt: Practice parsing CSV files in Python with the csv module, generators, pytest, and pandas, and get ready to discuss your solutions in an interview.
stories.lead:
In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Python Practice Problems: Parsing CSV Files.

By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how csv.DictReader turns rows into dictionaries, how to find a minimum with min() and a key function, how to refactor similar solutions into shared code, and when pandas is worth the extra dependency.

The quiz contains 10 questions and there is no time limit. You’ll get 1 point for each correct answer. At the end of the quiz, you’ll receive a total score. The maximum score is 100%. Good luck!

stories.title: Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain
stories.excerpt: The same day Dennes was given lethal injection, Florida carried out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year.
stories.lead:
HUNTSVILLE, Texas — Texas executed Reinaldo Dennes on Thursday in a procedure that took over an hour, as prison staffers struggled to find a suitable vein for the two intravenous needles carrying the lethal dose of the sedative pentobarbital.

And once it began, he moaned repeatedly about pain, groaned several times and asked God to take him away from the pain. A prison spokesperson said all procedures were followed appropriately and suggested that Dennes might have exaggerated or faked the pain.

stories.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
stories.excerpt: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.
stories.lead:
Russia targeted bridges in Kyiv and railway stations overnight in a major attack launched days after Ukraine badly damaged the strategically important Crimean Bridge.

Ballistic missiles hit key crossings in the capital during a nationwide assault which Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said was "one of the most massive strikes" of the war so far and left at least eight dead.

Russian President Vladimir Putin had threatened to retaliate for the attack on the Crimean Bridge, which the Kremlin built to link Russia and the occupied peninsula.

stories.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
stories.excerpt: Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it did not appear to be an accident when Western military exercises were taking place in the region.
stories.lead:
Poland says a Russian cruise missile was among three objects that violated its airspace early on Friday and Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it did not appear to be an accident when Western military exercises were taking place in the region.

Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

Russia has made no comment about the violations, which took place during one of its biggest aerial attacks on Ukraine since the start of the full-scale invasion in 2022. Eight people were killed in strikes on Kyiv and a station in Lviv,

stories.title: How exactly did Trump get so rich on crypto? We explain
stories.excerpt: President Trump has made billions of dollars in his second term — most of it in cryptocurrencies. Democrats are vowing to probe his businesses as they gear up to take over Congress next year.
stories.lead:
For the last year, Will Ragland and a team of researchers at the Center for American Progress — a left-leaning think tank in Washington, D.C. — have dedicated themselves to counting how much money President Trump and his family have made in his second term.

So far, they put the total at nearly $3 billion. More than 2 billion dollars of the earnings come from cryptocurrency ventures.

"You could probably combine all of the past presidents' income made during their time in office," Ragland says. "And it wouldn't come close to what we're seeing here."

stories.lead:
